description:
Follow-up to T-053, split out so the landing page's brand/design/motion work could ship without waiting on billing. T-053 ships with a placeholder waitlist/email-capture CTA; this ticket swaps that CTA for real Stripe Checkout once T-050 (Stripe billing: Checkout + customer portal + webhook entitlement) exists.

Scope: replace the placeholder signup form with pseudonymous signup → Stripe Checkout session → webhook-confirmed entitlement, per the original T-053 acceptance criteria ("a visitor can go from landing → pseudonymous signup → checkout → connected paid account").
title: Wire landing page CTA to live Stripe Checkout
